tasks.instruction: Annotate focus, clitics, tense, and agreement.
items: Waan fahmay walaacaaga; sidaas darteed waxaan soo jeedinayaa xal dhexe.
Warbixinta ayaan akhrinayay markii saaxiibkay xog cusub soo diray.
key: Somali combines suffixed articles, agreement, tense and negation with focus particles such as baa, ayaa and waxaa. Clitics and preverbal elements track participants, objects, direction and information structure; vowel length and register can distinguish meaning.
